title: Make a history-exempt commit excuse the job records it adds
summary: The exemption is honored only in invariant::check; jobs::check (crates/athena-gate/src/jobs.rs) still flags the 'landed' outcomes and score.json records an exempt commit adds. I read the request as making jobs::check skip exempt commits, using the same exempt list as the invariant check, with tests and a decision note.

defaults_applied.how: Add tests for exempt and non-exempt commits adding job records.
One focused change in the gate crate plus a decision note.
Doc comments and decision entry explain why records follow the exemption.

assumptions: Records-level violations come from jobs::check, which lacks the exemption early-return that invariant::check has.
The exemption excuses only the exempt commit's own added records, not records of later commits.
Other checks (content, secrets) are unchanged; only the per-record job-records check is changed.
docs/decisions.md has a numbered decision log where the next entry follows D67.

acceptance_criteria.text: jobs::check in crates/athena-gate/src/jobs.rs returns no violations for a commit on the [history] exempt list (the history walk's tip list; the parent's list for a per-commit check), using the same rule as invariant::check.
The exempt-commit test is shared by invariant::check and jobs::check (one helper), not duplicated.

A new test in athena-gate builds a history where an exempt commit adds an outcome saying landed and a score.json that would otherwise be flagged; run `cargo test -p athena-gate` to see the history check report no JobRecords violation for it.
A test shows a non-exempt commit adding the same records is still flagged, and a commit after the exempt one is not excused; run `cargo test`.
`cargo clippy` is clean, `cargo fmt --check` passes, and `cargo test` passes.
A decision entry in docs/decisions.md (and a CHANGELOG line) records that an exemption also excuses the records the commit adds, citing D66/D67.

out_of_scope: Verifying that ee4b0dd is in main's history
Changing the exempt list in athena.toml
Altering other history checks (secrets, content, configuration)
